text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I watched your training session. Looking 
good! You've really put what you learned 
into practice!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Hence, we shall intensify our training 
from now on. Inform the Umamusume so that 
they do not fall behind.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Keep up the good work. We're always 
watching over you.
